chapter: Early bands and New Orleans musicians
title: Outstanding trumpeters and drummers
summary: Emmett Hardy was top trumpeter; he also names other trumpeters and good Dixieland drummers like Buck Rogers and Monk Hazel.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Were there any outstanding trumpet players that you remember then?
He would be the one you'd be the top.
He'd be the top. Yeah, he'd been the top. Positively the top.
What about before him? Would there be any good ones before him?
Well, Tony Majada played fairly good trumpet. He played pretty good trumpet. Dan Hughes played pretty good trumpet. Pete Dickens played pretty good trumpet.

blocks.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
blocks.x: And you played with, what do you call him? Borgie Shalane? Well, he was a drummer.
He killed himself. He killed himself about six months ago. He played with what a Sphinx fan when we was in Memphis at Silver Slipper.
Who were some of the good drummers there?

Well, Leo Hade was a good drummer. Von Gammon was about the best. And Emmett Rogers was a pretty good Dixieland drummer. Buck Rogers was a pretty good Dixieland drummer. Monk Hazel was a good Dixieland drummer.

blocks.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
blocks.x: Monk Hazel was our boy's daughter drummer.
And Steve Woodrow was a pretty good drummer too.

blocks.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
